option_relations.rationale: Basosquamous carcinoma is a rare skin cancer with features of both basal cell and squamous cell carcinoma, matching the description of the patient's condition.
Invasive squamous cell carcinoma can have various subtypes, including those with basaloid features, which might be related to the patient's initial diagnosis.
Basal cell carcinoma is mentioned as a feature of the residual papules but does not directly relate to the primary diagnosis in question.
The diagnosis of basosquamous carcinoma after immunohistochemical revision directly corresponds to the leaf label for basosquamous carcinoma.
